description: U.S. Solar Photovoltaic System Cost Benchmark Q1 2018 is a data set deposited in DOE National Library of the Rockies (NLR) Repository by its authors Ran Fu, David Feldman. NREL has been modeling U.S. photovoltaic PV system costs since 2009. The U.S. Solar Photovoltaic System CostBenchmark Q1 2018 report benchmarks costs of U.S. solar PV for residential commercial and utility-scale systems built in the first quarter of 2018 Q1 2018.
